race.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: SOUL ASYLUM made a promising hurdling debut when third at Wexford 28 days ago and that run may well have been needed, so he's fancied to build on that and open his account over hurdles. Look Me is of obvious interest making hurdling debut for his top yard and could be the biggest threat, while Young Rebel has something to recommend too. SOUL ASYLUM (IRE) LOOK ME (FR) YOUNG REBEL (IRE)
